text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected (502/504/timeouts) for hosted API in us-west-2. Error rate spike ~6.2% over baseline. Threshold crossed at 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z
maya (oncall): on it, confirming... dashboards show gateway 502 spikes and a concurrent increase in kv prefix eviction rate
ernie (sre): checking logs, I see repeated 'kv shard eviction' warnings and 'cache miss storm' from prefix indexer. sample:
```
2026-03-15T09:11:52Z WARN prefix_cache.go:214 evicting shard=shard-7 backlog=1200 reason=oom
2026-03-15T09:11:52Z ERROR gateway.go:429 upstream=backend-12 502
```
jia (eng-runtime): paging in - could be prefetch eviction loop. Did we just roll the compacting GC on that pool? lucas any infra changes?
lucas (infra): no infra deploys in last hour. I did notice autoscaler bumped a few workers in that pool at 09:09 due to CPU spikes
maya (oncall): mitigation plan proposal: 1) reduce prefix cache prefetch concurrency on us-west-2 to 1 2) raise eviction-throttle to limit cascade 3) route 20% traffic to fallback model variant (lower mem) 4) enable additional KV read-retries for gateway
amanda (support): heads-up, two customers reported slow requests and increased 504s. ticket #INC-5122 created with logs attached
ernie (sre): executing quick fixes: toggling prefetch concurrency now -> `redwoodctl feature set-prefix-prefetch --region us-west-2 --concurrency 1`
jia (eng-runtime): echo, watching metrics. also rolling back the recent prefix-index compaction tweak for that pool.
incident-bot: command accepted, change initiated by ernie
maya (oncall): lucas can you temporarily pin the pool to prevent new workers from joining? we want stable memory footprint
lucas (infra): pinned pool gpu-pool-7 -> no autoscale up for 10m
amanda (support): update from customer A: timeouts reduced after initial reroute, still seeing a few 502s
jia (eng-runtime): adding a KV shadow read to collect miss patterns: `--kv-shadow=true --shadow-log=/tmp/prefix-shadows.log` capturing for 5m
ernie (sre): observed eviction rate dropping but cache miss rate still elevated. increasing BPF sampler for KV to get deeper traces
maya (oncall): starting handoff in 20m to @lia (pagerduty) and @amanda (support) for customer sync. main action items:
- keep eviction-throttle and prefetch concurrency low
- continue 20% traffic route to fallback until miss rate <1%
- gather sample of affected request IDs and attach to INC-5122
lia (pagerduty): acked, will take pager in 20
amanda (support): will run customer impact sweep and escalate if >5 customers affected
jia (eng-runtime): note: we should schedule a postmortem on prefix compaction flag. probably correlated with GC tweak
ernie (sre): lifting some immediate load via short-term 15s gateway circuit breaker to avoid fanout, applied now
maya (oncall): good. if no regression within 30m we start rolling back traffic route by 10% steps. keep updates here
incident-bot: REMINDER: Pager duty escalation timer set for 00:40:00
maya (oncall): handing over to lia and amanda for night monitoring. leaving runbook+commands in thread. thanks team :heart:
lia (pagerduty): taking over, will post hourly pings and escalate for any customer-impacting regression
